title: Raat Bhar Fatima Ke Rone Ki Goonjti Hai Sada Madine Mein
body:
Raat Bhar Fatima Ke Rone Ki Gonjti Hai Sada Madine Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Jane Kis Din Bichaye Ga Mehdi Aa Ke Farsh-e-Azza Madine Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Hath Pehlu Pe Kis Liye Aaya Neel Kaisa Hai Tere Chehre Par
Kya Bataye Gi Ja Ke Baba Ko Zulm Kaisa Howa Madine Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalta Darwaza Bhi Hatati Thi Haye Zahra Ke Bain Karti Thi
Aik Fizza Thi Bint-e-Sarwar Ka Jis Ne Matam Kiya Madine Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Ja Ke Baba Ki Qabar Par Bibi Jane Kis Dil Se Roz Kehti Thi
Ro Nahi Sakti Aap Ko Baba Aap Ki Fatima Madine Mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Akbar Ki Ya Imam-e-Zamaan Aik Hasrat Hai Pori Ho Jaye
Naam-e-Zahra Pe Ho Ada Maula Pursa Zanjeer Ka Madine Mein
